title: Episode 1: In the Heart of the Skyclave

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: An ancient kor planeswalker, lithomancer and guardian of Zendikar who seeks the lithoform core in a Skyclave to heal the plane.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: An elf planeswalker, voice of Zendikar's soul and former Gatewatch member who opposes Nahiri's use of the lithoform core.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage and planeswalker on Ravnica who secretly knows that Nicol Bolas is still alive.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A dead Gatewatch planeswalker whose memory guides Nissa.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A pyromancer planeswalker and former friend of Nissa.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: A planeswalker dragon who, with Sorin, urged Nahiri to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Sorin
entities.description: A planeswalker who, with Ugin, urged Nahiri to trap the Eldrazi on Zendikar.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The ancient dragon planeswalker whom Jace knows is still alive.

entities.name: Fern Elemental
entities.description: A tall elemental Nissa calls from a fern, which helps them and dies when Nahiri uses the key to stop the Roil.

entities.name: Felidar
entities.description: A huge hairless, antlered guardian beast that ambushes Nahiri and is killed.

entities.name: Geopede
entities.description: A giant geopede suspended as a trap in the Skyclave and killed by Nissa and Nahiri.

entities.name: Eldrazi
entities.description: The titanic beings Nahiri helped trap on Zendikar and who caused great damage.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers Nissa has lost.

entities.name: Kor
entities.description: The ancient people who built the Skyclaves; Nahiri is one.

entities.name: Zendikar
entities.description: The plane Nahiri and Nissa both guard and call home.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The city-plane where Jace lives and where Nissa is resented.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Nahiri did damage.

entities.name: Akoum
entities.description: A Zendikari continent of rock precipices and lava fields where the Skyclave rises.

entities.name: Skyclave
entities.description: An ancient kor floating fortress risen from the ground over Akoum.

entities.name: Murasa
entities.description: A Zendikari region where a second Skyclave holds the lock.

entities.name: Bala Ged
entities.description: Nissa's first home on Zendikar, wiped out by the Eldrazi.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: The Ravnican World-Tree whose spirit fell.

entities.name: Roil
entities.description: The chaotic upheaval of Zendikar's land, a symptom of the plane's sickness.

entities.name: Lithoform core
entities.description: A powerful, dangerous kor orb, the last in existence, which can stop the Roil but kills elementals.

entities.name: Skyclave key
entities.description: A glowing tile from the Skyclave's heart that holds some of the core's power and unlocks it.

events.summary: Nahiri studies a rising Skyclave on Akoum, planning to use its secrets to change the world.
events.quote: With those secrets, she was going to change the world.

events.summary: The Roil erupts and the ledge collapses, but Nahiri arrests her fall with lithomancy and builds a pillar.
events.quote: Her freefall slowed to a stop midair, until she was floating.

events.summary: Nissa joins Nahiri on the pillar and Nahiri says she may have a solution to heal Zendikar.
Nahiri and Nissa race up the Skyclave; Nahiri's stairs collapse and Nissa saves her with a vine.
They reach the Skyclave, and Nissa, haunted by Gideon's death, asks how they will find what they need.
events.quote: Nahiri, how are we going to find what we need in such a vast place?

events.summary: A felidar ambushes Nahiri in a darkened chamber; Nissa distracts it and Nahiri chains and kills it.
events.quote: Nahiri drove all seven blades into the felidar, making certain to hit its vulnerable points this time.

events.summary: Nissa calls a fern elemental that agrees to guide them to the Skyclave's heart.
events.quote: She closed her eyes and felt its life under her fingers

events.summary: The elemental taps a geopede trap and Nissa and Nahiri kill the fallen creature.
events.quote: The monster shrieked and twitched. Then it went limp and expired.

events.summary: In the heart of the Skyclave, Nahiri takes the key and reveals she seeks the last lithoform core; the key points to a Skyclave in Murasa.
events.quote: It roughly translates to lithoform core . And it's the last one in existence.

events.summary: Nahiri uses the key's power to stop the Roil and partly mend the Skyclave, but the fern elemental withers and dies.
Nissa demands the key; the two planeswalkers fight, and Nissa leaves for Ravnica.
events.quote: I can't just stand by and let this plane tear itself apart!

events.summary: Nissa asks Jace to help convince Nahiri to destroy the core, but Jace wants to study it and does not listen.
events.quote: I need Nahiri to destroy the lithoform core when she finds it.

events.summary: Nissa declares she will protect her home with or without the Gatewatch and planeswalks back to Zendikar.
events.quote: I'm going to protect my home. With or without the Gatewatch's help.

events.summary: Jace, keeping the secret that Bolas lives, plans to go to Zendikar.
events.quote: That the ancient, terrible dragon was still alive.

relations.note: She helped trap them on Zendikar and fought them.
relations.quote: She should have found a different plane to trap the Eldrazi in millennia ago.

relations.note: She listened to Ugin and Sorin about trapping the Eldrazi.
relations.quote: She should have never listened to Ugin and Sorin.

relations.note: They fight over the lithoform core.
relations.quote: She didn't think as she commanded the vines to snake around Nahiri's ankles and pull her to the ground.

relations.note: Nissa calls the elemental from a fern.
Nahiri's use of the key's power kills it.
She stabs it with seven swords.
relations.quote: The creature shrieked once, a long and terrible cry, and then went limp.

relations.note: Jace welcomes her and offers help.
relations.quote: but I know they are important to you. How can we help?

relations.note: Nissa grieves Gideon and asks herself what he would do.
relations.quote: And suddenly, the grief of his death hit her in a fresh wave.
